tests.name: Order object authorization
tests.description: Verify that a user cannot retrieve another user's order.

tests.name: User search SQL injection
tests.description: Verify that user-controlled input cannot alter the database query.

tests.name: Search output encoding
tests.description: Verify that attacker-controlled search input is safely encoded before rendering.

tests.name: Secret detection regression
tests.description: Verify that known laboratory secret patterns are not reintroduced into application source.

tests.name: Administrative function authorization
tests.description: Verify that non-administrative users cannot execute administrative functions.

tests.name: Secure infrastructure configuration
tests.description: Verify that remediated infrastructure does not restore the intentionally insecure network and permission settings.
